prompt:
Consider the following company information, reported as of 2026-02-13. Act as a credit rating analyst.
| Current ratio           | 2.29 |
| Retained earnings       | 1,385M |
| Current liabilities     | 6,019M |
| Current assets          | 13,790M |
| Shareholders' equity    | 18,899M |
| Total liabilities       | 27,401M |
| Total assets            | 58,167M |
| EBIT / operating income | 811M |
| Revenue                 | 5,633M |
Based only on the above and knowledge predating 2026-02-13, assign the issuer a letter credit rating on the 21-grade scale below (finest granularity you can justify). Choose exactly one label from: AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-, CC, C.
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The provided data show moderate balance-sheet leverage (liabilities/assets = 47 %) and solid short-term liquidity (current ratio = 2.29), but extremely weak profitability and efficiency (EBIT/TA = 1.4 %, sales/TA = 9.7 %, RE/TA = 2.4 %). These ratios place the firm well below investment-grade medians on every conventional credit metric and inside the distress zone on a partial Altman Z-score, supporting a mid-to-low speculative-grade rating.
DECISION: BB-
